shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail cd /workspace node server.js > /tmp/book-app.log 2>&1 & PID=$! cleanup() { kill $PID >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; } trap cleanup EXIT sleep 1 # initial home curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ | rg -n "My Books|Currently Reading|Finished|Add Book" # add one book RESP_HEADERS=$(mktemp) curl -sS -D "$RESP_HEADERS" -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3000/books '"\\ --data-urlencode \"title=The Pragmatic Programmer\" \\ --data-urlencode \"author=Andrew Hunt\" \\ --data-urlencode \"notes=Read chapter 1\" rg -n \""'^HTTP/|''^Location:" "$RESP_HEADERS" BOOK_ID=$(node -e '"'const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=\"/workspace/data/books.json\";const books=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,\"utf8\"));console.log(books[0]?.id||\"\")') # ensure it appears in reading list and detail page works curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ | rg -n \"The Pragmatic Programmer|Andrew Hunt|Mark Finished\" curl -sS \"http://localhost:3000/books/"'$BOOK_ID" | rg -n "The Pragmatic Programmer|Andrew Hunt|Read chapter 1" # mark finished curl -sS -D "$RESP_HEADERS" -o /dev/null -X POST "http://localhost:3000/books/$BOOK_ID/finish" rg -n "''^HTTP/|''^Location:" "$RESP_HEADERS" # verify moved to finished section and status updated curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ | rg -n "The Pragmatic Programmer|Finished|Currently Reading" curl -sS "http://localhost:3000/books/$BOOK_ID" | rg -n "Status: Finished" # print persisted JSON cat /workspace/data/books.json '

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"const dataFilePath|function readBooks|function writeBooks|function renderHomePage|function renderBookPage|function matchBookDetail|function matchFinish|if \\(req.method === \\\"GET\\\" && pathname === \\\"/\\\"\\)|if \\(req.method === \\\"POST\\\" && pathname === \\\"/books\\\"\\)|if \\(req.method === \\\"POST\\\" && finishId\\)|if \\(req.method === \\\"GET\\\" && detailId\\)|server.listen\" /workspace/server.js"
